knowledge:
- key_parameters: return_as=Specifies whether to return data as a "SpatialExperiment" (default) or "sce" (SingleCellExperiment) ;; graph_file=Path to the CSV file containing object relationships/interaction graphs when reading CellProfiler output ;; type=The method used to construct spatial graphs ("expansion", "knn", or "delaunay") ;; aggregate_by=Specifies whether to aggregate neighboring cell features by "metadata" or "expression" ;; method=The summarization method for cell-cell interactions ("classic", "conditional", "patch", or "interaction") ;; border_dist=The distance threshold in pixels to define and filter out border cells ;; expand_by=The distance in micrometers to expand the concave hull around detected cell patches ;; statistics=The distance statistic to calculate to cells of interest ("min", "max", "mean", "median")
- alternatives: cytomapper=Used for reading and visualizing multi-channel images and segmentation masks as CytoImageList objects ;; CATALYST=Used for pixel-level debarcoding, cutoff estimation, and applying compensation matrices during spillover correction ;; igraph=Used internally for community detection algorithms (e.g., "louvain", "walktrap")
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing single-cell data extracted from highly multiplexed imaging modalities (such as IMC, MIBI, cyclic immunofluorescence, or spatial transcriptomics) to perform spatial neighborhood analysis, spillover compensation, and cell-cell interaction testing.
- pitfalls: Low pixel intensities in single-spot acquisitions can make spillover estimation non-robust; use binAcrossPixels to sum consecutive pixels if needed ;; Mislabeled pixels or weak signals in spillover controls should be filtered out using filterPixels before computing the spillover matrix ;; Incorrectly connected cells may be observed at image borders; use findBorderCells to identify and exclude them ;; Patches consisting of only 1 or 2 cells cannot be expanded using patchDetection and will return NA for size in patchSize.

workflows.name: imc_data_import
workflows.intent: Read segmented single-cell data and features from CellProfiler or Steinbock pipelines into SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment objects.
workflows.stages: 1. Browse and select CellProfiler features using show_cpout_features. 2. Read CellProfiler output into a SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment using read_cpout. 3. Read Steinbock output into a SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment using read_steinbock. 4. Read raw TXT files into a CytoImageList object using readImagefromTXT.
workflows.code:
path <- system.file("extdata/mockData/cpout", package = "imcRtools")
show_cpout_features(path)
cur_path <- system.file("extdata/mockData/cpout", package = "imcRtools")
spe <- read_cpout(cur_path, graph_file = "Object_relationships.csv")
sce <- read_cpout(cur_path, graph_file = "Object_relationships.csv", return_as = "sce")
cur_path <- system.file("extdata/mockData/steinbock", package = "imcRtools")
spe <- read_steinbock(cur_path)
sce <- read_steinbock(cur_path, return_as = "sce")
path <- system.file("extdata/mockData/raw", package = "imcRtools")
cur_CytoImageList <- readImagefromTXT(path)

workflows.name: spillover_correction
workflows.intent: Quantify and estimate channel spillover from single-metal spot acquisitions to correct multiplexed pixel intensities.
input: metal_spot.txt (Single-metal spot pixel intensities from TXT)
metal_spot.tiff (Single-metal spot pixel intensities from TIFF)
workflows.stages: 1. Read single-spot data using readSCEfromTXT or readSCEfromTIFF. 2. Perform quality control visualization using plotSpotHeatmap. 3. (Optional) Sum consecutive pixels using binAcrossPixels to enhance weak signals. 4. Assign and filter pixels using CATALYST functions and filterPixels. 5. Estimate the spillover matrix using computeSpillmat.
workflows.code:
path <- system.file("extdata/spillover", package = "imcRtools")
sce <- readSCEfromTXT(path)
path <- system.file("extdata/spillover_tiff/img", package = "imcRtools")
image_df_path <- system.file("extdata/spillover_tiff/images.csv", package = "imcRtools")
panel_df_path <- system.file("extdata/spillover_tiff/panel.csv", package = "imcRtools")
sce <- readSCEfromTIFF(path, image_df_path, panel_df_path)
plotSpotHeatmap(sce)
plotSpotHeatmap(sce, log = FALSE, threshold = 200)
sce2 <- binAcrossPixels(sce, bin_size = 5)
library(CATALYST)
bc_key <- as.numeric(unique(sce$sample_mass))
assay(sce, "exprs") <- asinh(counts(sce)/5)
sce <- assignPrelim(sce, bc_key = bc_key)
sce <- estCutoffs(sce)
sce <- applyCutoffs(sce)
sce <- filterPixels(sce)
sce <- computeSpillmat(sce)
metadata(sce)$spillover_matrix

workflows.name: spatial_neighborhood_analysis
workflows.intent: Construct spatial graphs, aggregate neighbor features, detect spatial contexts, communities, patches, and calculate distances to cells of interest.
input: SingleCellExperiment.rds (SingleCellExperiment or SpatialExperiment object containing cell coordinates and metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Build spatial graphs using buildSpatialGraph. 2. Visualize spatial graphs using plotSpatial. 3. Aggregate neighbor metadata or expression using aggregateNeighbors. 4. Detect and filter spatial contexts using detectSpatialContext and filterSpatialContext. 5. Plot spatial contexts using plotSpatialContext. 6. Detect spatial communities using detectCommunity. 7. Find border cells using findBorderCells. 8. Detect and size cell patches using patchDetection and patchSize. 9. Calculate distances to cells of interest using distToCells.
workflows.code:
library(cytomapper)
data("pancreasSCE")
pancreasSCE <- buildSpatialGraph(pancreasSCE, img_id = "ImageNb", type = "expansion", threshold = 20)
pancreasSCE <- buildSpatialGraph(pancreasSCE, img_id = "ImageNb", type = "knn", k = 5)
pancreasSCE <- buildSpatialGraph(pancreasSCE, img_id = "ImageNb", type = "delaunay")
library(ggplot2)
library(ggraph)
plotSpatial(pancreasSCE, img_id = "ImageNb", node_color_by = "CellType", node_shape_by = "ImageNb", node_size_by = "Area", draw_edges = TRUE, colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph", directed = FALSE, scales = "free")
pancreasSCE <- aggregateNeighbors(pancreasSCE, colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "CellType")
pancreasSCE <- aggregateNeighbors(pancreasSCE, colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph", aggregate_by = "expression", assay_type = "exprs")
pancreasSCE <- buildSpatialGraph(pancreasSCE, img_id = "ImageNb", type = "knn", name = "knn_spatialcontext_graph", k = 15)
pancreasSCE <- aggregateNeighbors(pancreasSCE, colPairName = "knn_spatialcontext_graph", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "clustered_neighbors", name = "aggregatedNeighborhood")
pancreasSCE <- detectSpatialContext(pancreasSCE, entry = "aggregatedNeighborhood", threshold = 0.9, name = "spatial_context")
pancreasSCE <- filterSpatialContext(pancreasSCE, entry = "spatial_context", group_by = "ImageNb", group_threshold = 2, name = "spatial_context_filtered_group")
pancreasSCE <- filterSpatialContext(pancreasSCE, entry = "spatial_context", group_by = "ImageNb", cells_threshold = 15, name = "spatial_context_filtered_cells")
plotSpatialContext(pancreasSCE, entry = "spatial_context", group_by = "ImageNb")
plotSpatialContext(pancreasSCE, entry = "spatial_context", group_by = "ImageNb", return_data = TRUE)
set.seed(22)
pancreasSCE <- detectCommunity(pancreasSCE, colPairName = "expansion_interaction_graph")
pancreasSCE <- findBorderCells(pancreasSCE, img_id = "ImageNb", border_dist = 10)
pancreasSCE <- patchDetection(pancreasSCE, patch_cells = pancreasSCE$CellType == "celltype_B", colPairName = "expansion_interaction_graph", expand_by = 20, img_id = "ImageNb")
patchSize(pancreasSCE)
pancreasSCE <- distToCells(pancreasSCE, x_cells = pancreasSCE$CellType == "celltype_B", coords = c("Pos_X","Pos_Y"), statistics = "min", name = "minDist", img_id = "ImageNb")

workflows.name: interaction_permutation_testing
workflows.intent: Count and test the significance of cell-cell interactions across images using permutation testing, and visualize interaction networks.
input: SingleCellExperiment.rds (SingleCellExperiment or SpatialExperiment object with a constructed spatial graph and cell type labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Count interactions using countInteractions. 2. Test interactions via permutation using testInteractions. 3. Visualize interaction networks using plotInteractions. 4. Perform conditional cell ratio (CCR) analysis for conditional normalization.
workflows.code:
out <- countInteractions(pancreasSCE, group_by = "ImageNb", label = "CellType", method = "classic", colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph")
out <- testInteractions(pancreasSCE, group_by = "ImageNb", label = "CellType", method = "classic", colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph", BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(RNGseed = 123))
plotInteractions(out, pancreasSCE, group_by = "ImageNb", label = "CellType")
out <- testInteractions(pancreasSCE, group_by = "ImageNb", label = "CellType", method = "conditional", colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph", BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(RNGseed = 123))
cd <- as.data.table(colData(pancreasSCE))
cond_ratio_df <- as.data.table(colPair(pancreasSCE, "knn_interaction_graph"))[ , .(from_label = cd$CellType[from], to_label = cd$CellType[to], group_by = cd$ImageNb[from], from) ][, .(N = uniqueN(from)), by = .(group_by, from_label, to_label) ][cd[, .(total_from_type = .N), by = .(group_by = ImageNb, from_label = CellType)], on = .(group_by, from_label) ][, .(group_by, from_label, to_label, cond_ratio = N / total_from_type)]
out_cr <- merge( as.data.table(out)[, `:=`( group_by = as.integer(group_by), from_label = as.character(from_label), to_label = as.character(to_label) )], cond_ratio_df, by = c("group_by", "from_label", "to_label"), all.x = TRUE )
